_about: Words the strategy guides use for a fighter's own mechanics, explained on hover and in the guide's Key terms box. {fighter id: {note, terms: {word: {symbol, text}}}}: note explains them all; text, if given, adds to it for one word. Words match in any case.

little_red.note: Little Red's cards carry three basket symbols: wolfsbane 🌹, pelt 🐺 and knives ⚔️. An effect marked with a symbol only works if the card on top of your discard pile (your basket) shows the same symbol. Wild 🌟 counts as any one of them.

wild.text: Little Red's Basket and What's That In My Basket? are wild.
